title: RevisionTruth
description: What a synthetic revision pair is supposed to produce: `fixtures/compare/<scenario>/truth.json`, written by the generator (R1-07) and read by the comparison tests (R1-06). The generator plants the changes, so the truth file is the plan rather than an observation -- a test that fails against it means the engine disagrees with the drawing that was actually built. `clean_regions` is the other half of the check: an area where a cluster appears is a false positive, which is what catches an over-eager diff rule.

scenario.description: Directory name of the scenario, e.g. `S03_move`. Sorts the scenario list and names the test case.

description.description: What the scenario exercises, in Korean, one sentence.

before_dir.description: Sub-directory of the scenario holding the 변경 전 drawings, relative to `truth.json`.

after_dir.description: Sub-directory holding the 변경 후 drawings, relative to `truth.json`.

expected_pairs.description: One entry per sheet the comparison should report, in any order; the tests match on `sheet_no`.

notes.description: Anything a reader of a failing test should know -- known tolerances, why a handle is null, which rule the scenario is aimed at.

expected_pair.title: ExpectedPair
expected_pair.description: The expected outcome for one sheet.

sheet_no.description: Drawing number as printed in the title block. Null only for a scenario that deliberately omits it, in which case the pair is identified by position.

match_method.description: How the matcher is expected to pair the two frames. Null when the scenario does not constrain it.

expected_changes.description: Changes that were planted. A comparison may legitimately report more (a moved block drags its attributes along), so the tests assert that each of these is present rather than that the counts are equal.

expected_cluster_count.description: How many cloud marks the sheet should end up with. Null when the scenario does not pin it.

clean_regions.description: Boxes where nothing was changed. A cluster whose box intersects one of these is a false positive and fails the test.

expected_change.title: ExpectedChange
expected_change.description: One planted change. Handles are the generator's own, so they are known unless the scenario copies a whole file (which renumbers everything) -- then both are null and the box is what the test matches on.

etype.description: DXF record name of the changed entity.

layer.description: Layer the change is expected on. Omit when the scenario does not constrain it.

before_handle.description: Handle in the before drawing, or null when it cannot be known.

after_handle.description: Handle in the after drawing, or null when it cannot be known.

minor.description: Whether the fold rules are expected to call this change minor. A scenario built to test the 0.01mm tolerance sets this true.

minor_reason.description: The fold reason the rules are expected to record, or null when the change is not minor.

bbox.description: Where the change is, in the after drawing's world coordinates. Used to match when the handles are null.

note.description: What was planted, in prose, e.g. `door moved 1250 east`. Printed by a failing assertion.
